translations.EN: I couldn't head home.
translations.TL: Hindi ako nakauwi.

translations.EN: The path back home is completely blocked.
translations.TL: Ganap na may harang ang daan pabalik sa tahanan.

translations.EN: Failed to return. Too many hostiles along the route.
translations.TL: Bigo sa pag-uwi. Masyadong maraming kalaban sa ruta.

translations.EN: I couldn't find a safe way back to base.
translations.TL: Wala akong makitang ligtas na daan pabalik sa base.

translations.EN: Return trip failed. Had to double back.
translations.TL: Pumalpak ang pag-uwi. Kinailangang bumalik.

translations.EN: Unable to reach home safely right now.
translations.TL: Di makarating sa tahanan nang ligtas sa ngayon.

translations.EN: Tried heading back, but the streets were overrun.
translations.TL: Sinubukang umuwi, pero pinamumugaran ang mga kalsada.

translations.EN: Lost the route home in the chaos.
translations.TL: Nawala ang daan pauwi sa gitna ng gulo.

translations.EN: Can't reach base from this position.
translations.TL: Di maabot ang base mula sa pwestong ito.

translations.EN: Return to base aborted. Route compromised.
translations.TL: Itinigil ang pag-uwi sa base. May aberya sa ruta.

translations.EN: Okay, I'll head home.
translations.TL: Sige, uuwi ako.

translations.EN: Heading back to base now.
translations.TL: Pabalik na sa base ngayon.

translations.EN: Understood. Moving toward home.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Papatungo na sa tahanan.

translations.EN: I'll make my way back to our shelter.
translations.TL: Babalik ako sa silungan natin.

translations.EN: Returning to camp as ordered.
translations.TL: Babalik sa kampo ayon sa utos.

translations.EN: Right. Time to head home.
translations.TL: Sige. Oras na para umuwi.

translations.EN: Understood. Retracing my steps to base.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Binabalikan ang daan sa base.

translations.EN: On my way back home.
translations.TL: Papauwi na ako ngayon.

translations.EN: Got it. Returning to home coordinates.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko. Pabalik sa mga coordinate ng tahanan.

translations.EN: Heading inbound for home.
translations.TL: Papasok na pauwi.

translations.EN: Sure, I'll head home. See you back there soon!
translations.TL: Sige, uuwi ako. Kita tayo roon agad!

translations.EN: Sounds wonderful, friend. I'll get back to camp safely.
translations.TL: Napakaganda, kaibigan. Babalik ako sa kampo nang ligtas.

translations.EN: Heading home, partner! Make sure you stay safe too.
translations.TL: Pauwi na, kasama! Tiyakin mong mag-iingat ka rin.

translations.EN: I'll go keep the fire warm for when you return.
translations.TL: Pupunta ako para panatilihing mainit ang apoy pagbalik mo.

translations.EN: Great idea! I'll head home and stow our gear.
translations.TL: Magandang ideya! Uuwi ako at itatabi ang gamit natin.

translations.EN: Happy to head home. Don't stay out too late, friend!
translations.TL: Masayang uuwi. Huwag kang magpagabi sa labas, kaibigan!

translations.EN: On my way back to our safe place. Take care!
translations.TL: Papauwi na sa ligtas nating lugar. Mag-ingat ka!

translations.EN: Heading home with a smile. See you shortly, partner.
translations.TL: Pauwi nang may ngiti. Magkita tayo maya-maya, kasama.

translations.EN: I'll get things tidy back at base for us.
translations.TL: Aayusin ko ang mga gamit sa base para sa atin.

translations.EN: Heading home! Be careful on your way back.
translations.TL: Pauwi na! Mag-ingat ka sa pagbalik mo.

translations.EN: I'm still heading home.
translations.TL: Pauwi pa rin ako.

translations.EN: Already on my way back. Just navigating the path.
translations.TL: Pauwi na ako. Dumaraan lang sa ligtas na ruta.

translations.EN: Still traveling toward base. Be there soon.
translations.TL: Naglalakbay pa rin patungong base. Nandoon na agad.

translations.EN: I haven't stopped moving toward home.
translations.TL: Di ako humihinto sa paglakad pauwi.

translations.EN: Already heading home. Keep calm.
translations.TL: Pauwi na nga ako. Kumalma ka lang.

translations.EN: Still on the road home.
translations.TL: Nasa daan pa rin pauwi.

translations.EN: Almost there. Still heading for base.
translations.TL: Malapit na roon. Papatungo pa rin sa base.

translations.EN: Already following the return route.
translations.TL: Sumusunod na sa rutang pabalik.

translations.EN: Still en route to home. No need to yell.
translations.TL: Nasa biyahe pa rin pauwi. Di kailangang sumigaw.

translations.EN: I'm already on the way back.
translations.TL: Pauwi na talaga ako.

translations.EN: All right, I'm heading home. Guard the rear.
translations.TL: Sige, pauwi na ako. Bantayan mo ang likod.

translations.EN: I trust your call. I'll make sure base is secure.
translations.TL: Tiwala ako sa pasya mo. Titiyakin kong ligtas ang base.

translations.EN: Heading home, partner. Don't take unnecessary risks out here.
translations.TL: Pauwi na, kasama. Huwag sumugal sa panganib dito.

translations.EN: Understood. I'll be waiting at camp for your return.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Maghihintay ako sa kampo sa pagbalik mo.

translations.EN: Heading home. Make sure you come back in one piece.
translations.TL: Pauwi na. Tiyakin mong makababalik ka nang buo.

translations.EN: I'll hold down the fort until you get back.
translations.TL: Babantayan ko ang kuta hanggang sa makabalik ka.

translations.EN: Heading back. Trusting you to watch yourself.
translations.TL: Pabalik na. Nagtitiwala akong iingatan mo ang sarili mo.

translations.EN: I'll see you at home, friend. Stay vigilant.
translations.TL: Magkita tayo sa bahay, kaibigan. Manatiling mapagmatyag.

translations.EN: Returning to our haven. Stay alive for me.
translations.TL: Babalik sa kanlungan natin. Manatiling buhay para sa akin.

translations.EN: Understood. Heading back to secure our home.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Pabalik na para i-secure ang tahanan natin.

translations.EN: I'll head home.
translations.TL: Uuwi ako.

translations.EN: Going back now.
translations.TL: Babalik na ngayon.

translations.EN: Heading to base.
translations.TL: Papatungo sa base.

translations.EN: Understood. Home.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Bahay.

translations.EN: Fine. I'm leaving.
translations.TL: Sige. Aalis na ako.

translations.EN: Heading back alone.
translations.TL: Babalik mag-isa.

translations.EN: Going home. Whatever.
translations.TL: Uuwi na. Kahit ano pa.

translations.EN: All right. Heading back.
translations.TL: Sige. Pabalik na.

translations.EN: Returning.
translations.TL: Babalik na.

translations.EN: Moving toward shelter.
translations.TL: Papatungo sa silungan.

translations.EN: I can't head home right now.
translations.TL: Hindi ako makauuwi ngayon.

translations.EN: The road home is cut off by hordes.
translations.TL: Pinutol ng mga kawan ang daan pauwi.

translations.EN: I'm not leaving you out here alone. Can't go home.
translations.TL: Di kita iiwan dito nang mag-isa. Di ako uuwi.

translations.EN: Too much danger on the way back right now.
translations.TL: Masyadong maraming panganib sa daan pabalik ngayon.

translations.EN: Refusing to return home while we're surrounded.
translations.TL: Tumatangging umuwi habang napapaligiran tayo.

translations.EN: I have to finish what we started before I head back.
translations.TL: Kailangan kong tapusin ang sinimulan bago umuwi.

translations.EN: Can't head home. The gates are compromised.
translations.TL: Di makauwi. May sira ang tarangkahan.

translations.EN: Unable to return to base right now.
translations.TL: Di makabalik sa base sa ngayon.

translations.EN: I won't abandon the mission to go home now.
translations.TL: Di ko tatalikuran ang misyon para lang umuwi ngayon.

translations.EN: Return home rejected. Not safe to travel.
translations.TL: Tinatanggihan ang pag-uwi. Di ligtas maglakbay.
